title: Spring Security & Identity
intro: Spring Security interviews test whether you understand the filter chain, not just the annotations. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with security fundamentals (authentication vs authorization, the filter chain), then authentication and authorization (the core flows). JWT and OAuth2 — the stateless and delegated models most production apps use — follow, then SSO and SAML. Security configuration, CORS and CSRF, and testing are the applied tier. It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
